title: Lupine MLIP Elastic Benchmark Reproducible Artifact
description: Reproducibility package and raw results for a 16-element cubic-metal benchmark comparing 1x1x1 and 3x3x3 MatPES elastic-constant calculations, an ensemble arm, and a leave-one-out PCA correction operator. The tested correction operator worsened accuracy on this benchmark; that negative result is retained.
notes: Canonical result provenance records git_sha and host as unknown. The release binds the preserved result and raw JSON files by SHA-256 but does not retroactively infer those missing generation-time fields.
